known_risks: 中文：通过强制 JP v96 中该效果 ID 的全部直接检查来激活语义；PPC 编译器复制/合并的路径数量与 3DS ARM 不完全相同，需要实机逐场景验证。 / English: Activates the semantic effect by forcing every direct JP-v96 check for its effect ID; PPC compiler duplication/consolidation differs from the 3DS ARM build and requires gameplay verification across contexts.
license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：强制发动集中/Focus；大剑、弓、锤的蓄力时间约缩短 20%，太刀、双刀和斩击斧的相关槽增长约加快 20%。 状态：Runtime Experimental，默认关闭。 / English: Forces Focus; Great Sword, Bow, and Hammer charge time is about 20% shorter, while relevant Long Sword, Dual Blade, and Switch Axe gauges fill about 20% faster. Status: Runtime Experimental; disabled by default.
